title: Node C communication loss
description: Node C stops appearing in the reports for 25 s (e.g. a wiring or link fault), then returns. The feeder itself is electrically normal throughout.
what_to_look_for: Node C goes Stale after 3 s and Offline after 10 s (placeholders).
Feeder: DEGRADED — explicitly not an interruption, because missing data is not evidence of lost supply.
One NODE_OFFLINE event, closed when Node C returns.
